name: Nova Scotia
short: Efficiency Nova Scotia pays $300 to $600 per ton for a heat pump and $800 for a heat pump water heater when you book a home energy assessment, with up to $5,000 in total rebates. Moderate-income homes that heat with something other than electricity can add up to $5,000 more, and HomeWarming is free for low-income homes. The federal oil-to-heat-pump program closed on July 2, 2026, and we found no solar or battery rebate for homeowners.
